Name: Scarecrows N Sprinklers (Standalone) (AI Generated)
Author: EvilCowNinja
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Scarecrows take up enough room already. This mod lets you stick one on a sprinkler and use the same tile for both. Hold a scarecrow, stand next to a sprinkler, and click to attach it. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Works with regular scarecrows, rarecrows, and deluxe scarecrows, keeping their normal protection ranges. Your sprinkler carries on watering as usual.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Want it back? Hit it with an axe or pickaxe to remove the scarecrow first.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]I wanted to be forthcoming and disclose it was AI created and refined by me. If you don't like it, don't install it. It's that simple.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Just take the folder named ScarecrowsNSprinklers and put it in your mod folder. [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.4+[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Single-player only[/color][/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Scarecrows N' Sprinklers
Manifest.Description: Place scarecrows on sprinklers to save space while keeping crops watered and protected.
